title: 第007章 天骄的荣誉第008章 那是一本
lines: 在于飞煌夸张的笑声和毫不留情的讽刺下，郭展鹏脸色一黑，“行了，你们都是同学，别过分。”
辅导员的面子，于飞煌还是给一点的，不在说的那么明显，只是他笑容并没有消减，看着苏恒的视线依旧充满了嘲弄。
郭展鹏再次看向苏恒，他刚才主动那么说，就是想让这个让他心生好感觉得很不错的好学生，认清现实！
真的不用谈理论知识储备。
只说修为和术法！
一株灵植生长过程需要的东西太多了，阳光、气温、水、土壤、各种微量元素和人工肥料等等等。
全地球天然的灵植宝药、生长效率远比不上无穷强者的吃货效率，灵木师凭什么高贵？他们掌握着快速催生、急速培育灵植的能力。
培育过程，你只有木系天赋的话，就无法掌握控制阳光光照、红外线紫外线照射的明光术，也无法掌握控制温度变化的变温术，更无法掌握分离合成特殊土壤、调控微量元素的离土术，等等等。
为什么说木神术是灵木师最最最最重要的术法？只有木系天赋的话，只要掌握木神术，哪怕你无法使用明光术、变温术等等，也可以靠木系最精纯最庞大的本源生命力，以自身的澎湃壮大去抵消其他的侧面影响。
一个木神术，能抵消灵木师所有的其他天赋不行的缺陷。
偏偏在郭展鹏心目中中，苏恒的木神术也一般，远不如于飞煌等人。
这是实践上全方位实力差距，不是歧视，是摆在明面上的事实。
就算苏恒能在理论知识大爆，那也只是100分，一个实践上的100分缺陷，能让他绝望。
真正的超级学霸，哪个不是全方位掌握多种辅助型术法？木神术同样不差，好吧，所有大一学霸的术法连1级效果都谈不上，1级已是大四毕业生里优秀水准，别说于飞煌不入级，大四毕业生又有多少人入级了？一个班级不到一小半人吧。
2级是1市之地上亿人类，百万计修炼者里最精英存在。
他印象中如于飞煌、李亚琳，多种术法已经是普通或精通掌控了，苏恒却只有育灵术普通，外加飞藤术、花神术两个战斗型术法。
只要苏恒认清现实，自己还没把他的名字报上去，只要他后悔了就可以不报了，免得面对更多如于飞煌这样的家伙。这类不留情面肆无忌惮的嘲讽，对一个青少年成长极为不利。
可郭展鹏失望了，他充满好意，看到的还是毫无波动的苏恒，他都想吐槽这货面瘫了么？以前的苏恒没这么冷啊。
心下一叹，他才看向于飞煌，“你也是来报名的？”
于飞煌乐呵呵点头，“大一700多人唯一一个名额，虽然不少时候被王会压一头，但我觉得最近进步挺大，还是有实力和王会争一争的，争那么一个唯一，可不像有些人故意跳出来只是博人一笑。”
郭展鹏点头。
他不知道此刻苏恒正在观察对手的实力，大战之前了解每一个对手，是很有必要的。
查探目标：于飞煌。
灵木系进化方向。
修为：灵化四重。
综合评价：理论知识98，实践能力98！
满分一百分，这货不管理论还是实践，都接近满级了。
苏恒再次一叹，1级入门是全国范围优秀大学毕业生水准了，一个大一还没毕业的家伙，所有能力都这么强，的确有自傲的资本。
片刻后，三道身影一前两后离开办公楼，等前方又走来一道身影，苏恒没有理会，他后面几米外的于飞煌招手笑道，“王会，你也是来报名的？”
王会是一个19岁面容小清秀的青少年，家世背景很不错，他自身……其实不怎么努力，不努力的人为什么制霸全系？
地球的修炼盛世里，大部分人类都因为十四五岁之前身体在急速生长，这阶段不太适合提前修炼，否则会因为修炼，一次次打破DNA生命枷锁而进化，影响你的急速发育期导致畸形。
你说有人十四五后才发育？发育晚？这在大明一代代灵植养育下根本不存在这问题。
大部分普通人都是中考时期才因天赋进入进化类高中，有钱人和贵族不在此列，他们可以靠家世背景资源搞来灵植宝药，在药物帮助下，六七岁或七八岁就可以修炼。
苏恒15岁接触修炼，王会10岁就开始了。
五年时间差才是他轻松制霸的原因，有钱人，也不用等着随修为提升一步步进化脑域，直接购买在你还是普通人时期就让你耳聪目明的丹药，也很简单。
轻松制霸全系，王会为人很傲。
content_en:
Under Yu Feihuang's exaggerated laughter and merciless sarcasm, Guo Zhanpeng's face darkened, "Okay, you are all classmates, don't go too far."
Yu Feihuang still gave Yu Feihuang a little respect as a counselor, not so obviously, but his smile did not diminish, and his eyes looking at Su Heng were still full of ridicule.
Guo Zhanpeng looked at Su Heng again. He took the initiative to say that just now because he wanted this good student who made him feel good to recognize the reality!
There is really no need to talk about theoretical knowledge reserves.
Just talk about cultivation and magic!
The growth process of a spiritual plant requires too many things, including sunlight, temperature, water, soil, various trace elements, artificial fertilizers, etc.
The growth efficiency of the earth's natural spiritual plant treasures is far inferior to the food efficiency of the infinitely powerful. Why is the spiritual wood master so noble? They have the ability to quickly generate and cultivate spiritual plants.
In the cultivation process, if you only have wood-type talent, you will not be able to master the bright light technique to control sunlight and infrared ultraviolet irradiation, nor the temperature-changing technique to control temperature changes, nor the soil-leaving technique to separate and synthesize special soil, control trace elements, etc.
Why is the Wood Divine Technique said to be the most important technique among spiritual wood masters? If you only have wood talent, as long as you master the wood magic, even if you cannot use bright light, temperature change, etc., you can still rely on the purest and largest original vitality of the wood to offset other side effects with your own growth.
A wood magic can offset all the shortcomings of the spiritual wood master's other talents.
However, in Guo Zhanpeng's mind, Su Heng's wood magic was average and far inferior to Yu Feihuang and others.
This is an all-round strength gap in practice. It is not discrimination, but a fact that is obvious.
Even if Su Heng could excel in theoretical knowledge, it would only be 100 points. A 100-point flaw in practice would make him despair.
Who is a true super academic master who does not master a variety of auxiliary spells in all aspects? The Mu Shen Technique is not bad either. Well, all the magic techniques of the first-year academic masters are not even effective at level 1. Level 1 is already an excellent level among senior graduates. Not to mention Yu Feihuang is not at the level, how many senior graduates are there? There are less than half of the people in a class.
Level 2 is the most elite existence among the hundreds of millions of human beings in City 1 and the millions of cultivators.
In his impression, Yu Feihuang and Li Yalin were already ordinary or proficient in many kinds of spells, but Su Heng only had ordinary spiritual cultivation skills, plus two combat-type spells, Flying Vine Technique and Flower God Technique.
As long as Su Heng recognizes the reality, he hasn't reported his name yet, and as long as he regrets it, he can stop reporting it, so as not to face more guys like Yu Feihuang. This kind of merciless and unscrupulous ridicule is extremely detrimental to the growth of a teenager.
But Guo Zhanpeng was disappointed. He was full of good intentions, but what he saw was Su Heng who was still without any fluctuations. Did he want to complain about this guy's facial expression? Su Heng wasn't so cold before.
After sighing in his heart, he looked at Yu Feihuang, "Are you here to sign up too?"
Yu Feihuang nodded happily, "There is only one spot among the more than 700 people in the freshman year. Although I am often beaten by the Wanghui, I feel that I have made great progress recently and I still have the strength to compete with the Wanghui. Fighting for such a unique spot is not like some people who deliberately jump out just to make others laugh."
Guo Zhanpeng nodded.
He didn't know that Su Heng was observing the strength of his opponents at this moment. It was necessary to understand each opponent before a battle.
Exploration target: Yu Feihuang.
The evolution direction of the spiritual wood system.
Cultivation: Fourth level of spiritualization.
…
Comprehensive evaluation: theoretical knowledge 98, practical ability 98!
With a perfect score of 100 points, this guy is close to reaching the full level in both theory and practice.
Su Heng sighed again. Level 1 entry level is the level for graduates from outstanding universities across the country. A guy who has not yet graduated from his freshman year has such strong abilities in all aspects and is indeed proud of himself.
…
After a while, three figures left the office building one after the other. When another figure came in front, Su Heng ignored it. Yu Feihuang, who was a few meters behind him, waved and smiled, "Wang Hui, are you here to sign up too?"
Wang Hui is a 19-year-old handsome young man with a good family background. He himself... actually doesn't work very hard. Why do people who don't work hard dominate the entire department?
In the golden age of cultivation on earth, most humans were growing rapidly before the age of fourteen or fifteen. This stage is not suitable for early cultivation, otherwise the shackles of DNA life will be broken again and again through cultivation and you will evolve, which will affect your rapid growth period and lead to deformities.
You said there are people who develop after 14 or 15? Late development? This problem did not exist at all under the upbringing of generations of Lingzhi in the Ming Dynasty.
Most ordinary people enter evolutionary high schools due to their talents during the high school entrance examination. The rich and nobles are not included in this group. They can rely on their family background to obtain spiritual medicine. With the help of the medicine, they can practice at the age of six or seven or seven or eight.
Su Heng came into contact with cultivation at the age of 15, and Wang Hui started at the age of 10.
The five-year time difference is the reason why he easily dominates. Rich people don't have to wait to evolve their brains step by step as their cultivation level increases. It is also very simple to directly buy the elixir that made you bright and clear when you were an ordinary person.
Easily dominate the entire system, Wang Hui is very proud.
